cases.name: Heather Ann Porter
cases.about: She was a daytime student at the Good Shepherd Center, a school for "troubled girls" which was operated by the Catholic Sisters of the Good Shepherd.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: On 9/24/1981, her body was found by a man walking his dog in a wooded area near Ridgewood Road and Goucher Boulevard in Towson.
